T: Eleven guys. Three casinos. One very long buffet.
D: Danny Ocean gathers a crew to rob three Las Vegas casinos in one night.
P: Serve the prawn cocktail whenever Rusty is eating, which is most scenes.
S: Rusty eats in nearly every scene
Prawns poached in salted water for 2 minutes, iced, served in martini glasses over shredded iceberg with a sauce of tomato sauce, horseradish, lemon and Worcestershire.
the chips on the high-stakes table
Potatoes sliced paper thin on a mandoline, rinsed, dried, fried at 170C until golden, tossed straight away with truffle salt and finely grated parmesan.
M: Benedict's casino rib eye with béarnaise

Dry-brined rib eye seared hard and rested, with a buttery tarragon béarnaise, creamed spinach and a crisp shoestring fry stack. Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon and a chopped shallot to 1 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over simmering water and drizzle in 200g warm melted butter. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze and simmer in 200ml cream. Bake 600g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest 8 minutes.
Saul, the old con man coaxed out of retirement

Golden chicken broth simmered with onion, carrot and celery, with fluffy matzo balls, shredded chicken, fresh dill and cracked pepper. Simmer 1kg chicken thighs on the bone in 2L water with an onion, 2 carrots and 2 celery sticks for 1 hour. Strain, shred the chicken and slice the carrots back in. Mix 120g matzo meal, 3 eggs, 3 tbsp melted chicken fat or oil, 3 tbsp broth and salt and chill 30 minutes. Roll into 12 balls and simmer in the broth, covered, for 30 minutes. Finish with dill.
W: the crew watching the fountains at the end
Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses, hot fudge made from dark chocolate and cream, whipped cream piped high and a few gold sprinkles to catch the light.
K: 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth stirred with ice for 30 seconds, strained into a chilled glass, a green olive on a pick.

s.note: Rusty eats in nearly every scene
s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce, 1 tbsp horseradish, lemon juice and a dash of Worcestershire. Serve over shredded iceberg in martini glasses with lemon wedges.

s.note: the chips on the high-stakes table
s.how: Slice 600g potatoes paper thin on a mandoline, rinse and dry very well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden. Toss straight away with truffle salt and 30g finely grated parmesan so it sticks. Serve in a silver bowl.

m.n: Benedict's casino rib eye with béarnaise
m.how: Dry-brine 4 rib eyes overnight. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with tarragon and a chopped shallot to 1 tbsp, whisk with 3 yolks over simmering water and drizzle in 200g warm melted butter. Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze and simmer in 200ml cream. Bake 600g shoestring fries at 220C for 20 minutes. Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest 8 minutes.

w.note: the crew watching the fountains at the end
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses and pour over the fudge. Pipe whipped cream high and scatter gold sprinkles so they catch the light.

d.how: For each drink, stir 60ml gin and 10ml dry vermouth over plenty of ice for 30 seconds until very cold. Strain into a chilled martini glass and add a green olive on a pick. Makes four.
